question: U Srinivas is a famous player of which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandolin.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **U Srinivas is a famous player of Mandolin, a stringed musical instrument that belongs to the lute family.**
 
• **He is known for his unique style of playing the Mandolin, which is a blend of Indian classical music and Western music.**
 
• U Srinivas has won several awards for his contribution to music, including the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
 
• He has collaborated with many renowned musicians from around the world, such as** John McLaughlin, Michael Brook, and Zakir Hussain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Violin is a bowed stringed musical instrument that is widely used in classical music.**

 
 
• It has a similar shape to the Mandolin, but it has four strings instead of eight.
 
 
 
• **Sitar is a plucked stringed musical instrument that is commonly used in Indian classical music.**
 
 
• It has a long neck and a gourd-shaped body.
 
 
 
• Guitar is a plucked stringed musical instrument that is used in various genres of music, such as rock, pop, and folk.
 
 
• **It has six strings and a flat body.**
